assessment.requirement: The PNG decode operation must be able to request supported RGBA16 output with gAMA correction when accepted input supplies stored gamma data.
assessment.target_route: Fuzzer bytes pass through spng_set_png_buffer, spng_decoded_image_size and spng_decode_image; the source conditionally allocates a 65,536-entry table, fills it, applies pixel lookups and frees it with the context.
assessment.failure_condition: If the format constants and decode flags are distinct, the harness's fixed RGBA8 format and SPNG_DECODE_USE_TRNS flag prevent it from selecting the RGBA16 gamma route.
assessment.alternative_paths: The complete harness has one size call and one decode call with fixed arguments. The missing constant definitions prevent a definitive ruling on whether its flag activates the gamma guard.
